subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on ₹8,500 in 2 years at 6% per annum, interest being compounded half-yearly.
solution:
Given:

Principal = ₹8,500

Time = 2 years

Rate of interest = 6% per annum

Concept used:

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

Where, P = Principal,

R = Rate of interest

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Interest is being compounded half-yearly, therefore

The rate will be halved and Time will be doubled

⇒ 8500(1 + {{6 over 2} over 100})² × ² - 8500

⇒ 8500(1 + 3/100)⁴ - 8500

⇒ 8500 (1.03⁴ - 1)

⇒ 8500 × 0.1255

⇒ 1066.824 ≈ ₹1,066.82

**∴ The compound interest is ₹1,066.82.**
